{{Quote|The New Republic pressed its advantage and entered Moff Getelles's Antemeridian sector with two full ﬂeets. Getelles was powerless to stop them, and the sector (allong with a huge chunk of neighboring space) became New Republic territory. Admiral Pellaeon, initially preoccupied with a protracted campaign against Adumar, eventually stopped his enemy from advancing into the heart of the Empire.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="TNEC" />}}
The '''invasion of the Antemeridian sector''' occurred in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] during the low-intensity phase of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Eight years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles]] still ruled the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]], in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]]. Getelles tried to take control of the neighboring [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] with support of the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] and former [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] by releasing the [[Death Seed]] plague. However, they were defeated by the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] assisted by [[Natasi Daala]] during the [[Battle of Nam Chorios]]. In retaliation, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] attacked the Antemeridian sector with two full [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]]. Getelles's Imperial forces were unable to stop them, and the sector along with a huge part of neighboring space fall in New Republic territory. During those events, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] was involved in a [[Campaign against Adumar|campaign]] against [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. As the New Republic pushed through the Borderland Regions toward the border of [[Imperial Space]], the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] ordered Pellaeon to move his forces and engage the New Republic. Admiral Pellaeon would stop the New Republic advance,<ref name="TNEC" /> despite being eventually [[Battle of Celanon|defeated]].<ref name="TEA" />
